title: The Jewish Girl
summary: Little Sara was a poor Jewish maiden whose dying mother had extracted a sacred promise: "Remain faithful to the religion of your fathers."...
full_text:
Little Sara was a poor Jewish maiden whose dying mother had extracted a sacred promise: "Remain faithful to the religion of your fathers."

Living as a servant in a Christian home, Sara heard the beautiful hymns of the church and loved their message of peace and love. Yet she remembered her solemn vow to her mother and never formally converted, though her heart was filled with Christian charity and devotion.

When she died, the laws of the era forbade her burial in the churchyard. But as her humble grave was dug outside the wall, a beam of golden sunlight fell upon the mound, and angels sang that the God of Abraham and of all mankind receives into His kingdom every soul that walks in truth, love, and fidelity.
moral: Faithful adherence to an honest conscience and filial promise is crowned with divine grace.
